opportunities.title: Attempted transport from tracial factor absorption to reduced C*-norm absorption
opportunities.exact_endpoint: For every epsilon>0, inside D=C*_r(F_{n+1}), there are unitaries U_j with max_j ||U_j-A_j||<epsilon and a word w with ||w(U)-C||<epsilon.
opportunities.countertheorem: For every n>=1, every n unitaries U_j in D individually at norm distance <2 from A_j, and every word w in F_n, ||w(U)-C||=2.
opportunities.historical_importance: A rank-changing norm-classification theorem would concern a different foundational object; it conflicts with the established canonical K1 basis of the reduced group C*-algebra.
opportunities.strongest_prior_work: Pimsner-Voiculescu 1982 Corollary 3.2: K1(C*_r(F_m))=Z^m with canonical generator basis.
opportunities.mechanism: Norm distance <2 between unitaries gives homotopy and equal K1 class. The first n perturbed generators cannot supply the independent final K1 coordinate.
compatibility_obligations: Unitaries must lie in the SAME reduced group C*-algebra D.
The original Borel-log flow is allowed to leave D and is not refuted.
opportunities.early_falsifier: Compare the K1 coordinate of C to every word in the perturbed active tuple before attempting a norm iteration.
opportunities.scoped_consequence: For free Haar U_j, B=C*(U) has dist(C,B)=1 and dist(C,unitaries(B))=2.
opportunities.source_validation_dependency: None for the obstruction; established K-theory is imported and its published statement was visually inspected.

opportunities.title: Optimal regularity cost of erasing Haar winding in L2
opportunities.exact_theorem: For every real 2pi-periodic L-Lipschitz h, ||exp(i h(C))-C||_2^2>=2/(L+1) and the operator norm error is 2 for a Haar unitary C. For every L>=1 a centered bounded piecewise linear h attains equality.
opportunities.historical_importance: Quantifies the unavoidable regularity and Fourier coefficient cost at the source's continuous-log replacement gate; not a further foundational classification theorem.
opportunities.strongest_prior_work: The source uses a centered Mobius phase with squared L2 error 2(1-r) and maximal derivative 2r/(1-r), then Laurent approximation. Classical winding already forbids uniform approximation by continuous logarithms.
opportunities.mechanism: For phi=h-theta, periodicity forces a full winding difference. The primitive of 2-2cos integrates to 4pi across that winding; the Lipschitz cap forces an L2 cost. An odd piecewise linear branch transition attains it.
compatibility_obligations: Haar spectral distribution and trace-normalized L2 metric.
Finite regularity of a continuous REAL periodic phase, not an arbitrary unitary map.
The Borel logarithm has infinite regularity cost and lies outside the theorem's hypotheses.
supplied_information: The spectral distribution of C is exactly Haar; no acquisition step is present.
opportunities.charged_cost: L>2*epsilon^-2-1, and for finite Laurent coefficients Lambda=sum |k a_k|>2*epsilon^-2-1. The optional degree bound also imports Bernstein's inequality.
opportunities.early_falsifier: At the branch transition the error must equal 2. Check the chain-rule integral and the explicit centered sharpness phase.
opportunities.likely_significance: A sharp local gate and asymptotic factor-two phase-regularity improvement over the source Mobius construction; no demonstrated end-to-end speedup.

opportunities.title: Near-canonical weakly dense proper reduced C*-subalgebra
opportunities.exact_theorem: If the one-step premise H_n of proofs.txt holds inside D=C*_r(F_{n+1}), then for every delta>0 a free Haar n-tuple U in D norm delta-close to the first n canonical generators weakly generates L(F_{n+1}); C is nevertheless at exact norm distance 1 from C*(U) and 2 from its unitaries.
opportunities.mechanism: Adapt the source's summable future budgets and L2 target enumeration to C*-automorphisms of the SAME D; active tuple norm limits remain in D.
opportunities.load_bearing_missing_lemma: Independent validation of the source's Laurent-phase small-cocycle one-step theorem as a C*-automorphism of the SAME D; the implication H_n->conclusion is reconstructed.
compatibility_obligations: Do not assume the current completed tuple merely von Neumann generates D.
All finite maps and reverse ODE solutions must preserve D.
Final generation is weak/L2, while the norm obstruction persists.
opportunities.early_falsifier: Any attempt to make C norm approximable by the limiting subalgebra violates the K1 obstruction.
opportunities.likely_significance: A precise surviving embedding-flexibility corollary if the foundational source mechanism is validated; its priority and incremental significance remain unknown.
